notes: Bench-only fixture set. Assets live under scripts/short-video/assets/ and are gitignored (pexels-*), so a fresh worktree does not have them — pass --assets-dir.
`design` is the review-time intent recorded by the agent that built this bench; it is NOT ground truth. Ground truth is labels.json, written by a human through `queue`'s accept/reject page.
Claims are shaped like production claims: `voiceover` is the scene narration, `assetNeed` is the declared visual (as aiImage.prompt / aiVideo.prompt would supply it).
Only the image track is in scope (#541 body). The two videos in the design doc stay out until the image arm concludes.

B.seen: macro of a circuit board behind a wire fence, magenta/pink grade, no readable brand

C.seen: printed bar-chart poster (English month labels) with a phone on top showing a stacked bar chart

D.seen: blurred HTML source on a dark screen, Cyrillic strings, no repository or brand chrome

E.seen: server-room aisle, rows of racks, no readable brand

F.seen: upward view of a glass atrium / curtain wall against a flat blue sky, no logo
